_meta._note: Machine-readable copy rules read by the copy lint (P1-H02) and the client formatter. Limits are display cells as defined in copy-schema 4.1. Variables are NOT here: the variable registry is copy.th.json#_variables. The Thai description in copy.th.json#_meta.limits must match these numbers (copy gate checks by eye).

limits._source: design/narrative/style-guide.md 4.3; A-P1-F03-T03-1 (uiux-designer confirms in P1-F03-T17); D-023 (legal summary line, pending HUMAN)

buttonFullWidth._source: D-050 (uiux-designer, ACCEPTED): a single full-width primary button with no paired button may take >= 16 cells
buttonFullWidth._note: Selection rule for the lint (copy-schema 3.2, proposed row placed before 'kind: button'): kind = button AND key is listed in keys -> use this limit, otherwise limits.button. A key may be listed only if its screen shows it as the only full-width primary button (uiux-designer confirms in components.md section 10). Every listed key must exist in copy.th.json and have kind button.
